text:
nima: Quick rollup from enterprise pilots: three customers want per-tenant audit segregation, two demand BYOK, and several ask for retention between 5-7 years. Healthcare pilot adds region-bound retention. Link with raw notes: https://tiny.redwood/comp-signal

oliver: Can we be explicit on scope tradeoffs? BYOK onboarding + per-tenant audit are orthogonal but both affect ops. Escrow automation is heavier legal work.

sasha: Tech note: per-tenant audit partitioning = tenant_id at ingest -> per-tenant index + ACL gates. Estimate for MVP: 2 engs x 3wks (no cross-tenant aggregation). Storage impact for 7yr retention needs modeling.

rachel: SOC2/ISO evidence packaging request from security teams: customers want export bundles for audits. That's an integration task (format + retention of evidence). Suggest we scope as Sprint 3.

legal: Two escrow models to consider: (1) court-order only release; (2) customer-authorized release with ops dual-signer. Each has different legal exposure. Need product to choose preferred default.

sales-rep: Pricing demand: customers expect to pay for long-term storage. Sales needs a stubbed price (cold storage $/GiB/mo + retrieval fee) and a one-line value prop for BYOK vs BYOK+escrow. Two deals pending on a commitment.

infra-bot: FYI  current BYOK onboarding is manual; average 2.5h/tenant. HSM-only imports add 1-2 days ops work.

nima: Proposed roadmap splits (opinionated):
- Sprint A (next): per-tenant audit partitions (MVP), retention TTL hook to cold archive, sales stub doc.
- Sprint B: BYOK onboarding UX & API, rotation docs, verification checklist. Manual escrow pilot process (ops-mediated).
- Sprint C: Escrow automation connectors, multi-region retention UI, SOC2/ISO audit export tooling.

oliver: Risks: shard proliferation, prefix cache invalidation, read amplification for aggregated queries, and key rotation implications for long-term encryption. Call these out before committing SLOs.

sasha: I'll run a storage-growth sim and query perf tests with synthetic 20-tenant 7yr dataset, deliver by Tue.

legal: I'll draft two contract stubs for the escrow models and annotate risks. Need product to confirm which model to present to customers.

sales-rep: I'll draft the pricing stub and an ops cost line (incremental $/GiB/mo) for the sales playbook.

nima: Decision memo plan: consolidate perf sim, legal stubs, and pricing into a 1-pager for leadership review on Thu. Action owners: @sasha perf sim, @legal escrow clauses, @sales-rep pricing. Use this thread as canonical. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Suggest adding backlog tags: SIGNAL:FinServ, SIGNAL:Healthcare so PMs can sort by revenue/regulatory impact.

sasha: Ack  will post results here when ready.

legal: Also flag jurisdictional export rules for region-bound retention; will add to clauses.

nima: Thanks all. If anyone gets additional contractual asks, drop them here so we can fold into the memo. :rocket:
